definitions.explanation: Days from Monday to Friday, working days.

examples.japanese: {平日|へいじつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧。
{平日|へいじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧。
{平日|へいじつ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧。
{平日|へいじつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧6⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I wake up at 6 every morning on weekdays.

examples.japanese: {平日|へいじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}ると→取る：00565_toru⟧、⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{空|す}いていて→空く：11062_aku⟧⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: When I take a day off on a weekday, everywhere is empty and comfortable.

notes:
{平日|へいじつ} means a regular weekday — any day that is not a weekend or public holiday. In Japan, many businesses offer different {平日|へいじつ} rates and schedules.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {平日|へいじつ}⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧: weekdays only
- {平日|へいじつ}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: weekday rate (often cheaper)
- {平日|へいじつ}⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧: weekday timetable/schedule
- {平日|へいじつ}⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧: weekday-only (deal, menu, etc.)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {平日|へいじつ}: weekday (Mon–Fri, non-holiday)
- ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧: day off, holiday
- ⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧: national/public holiday
- ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧: weekend

Note: In Japan, ⟦{土曜日|どようび}→土曜日：00621_doyoubi⟧ (Saturday) is sometimes treated as a {平日|へいじつ} and sometimes as a ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧, depending on the context.
